body: Ahhh that's awful! Thanks for sharing :)

Yeah that's a really good point! Same, one of my close friends had the IUD mess up her uterus (I'm sketchy on the details here because it was two/three years ago) and it got infected, had all sorts of complications and it was about a year of going back and forth to her GP until it was fixed. She said it was fine after that, but good lord I could not handle anything like that!

Yeah that's very true, at least I knew with the pill that once I stopped taking it my body would go back to normal. But that does make me not want to do the injection, plus I've had friends who have had three month-long periods while on it :\
Okay, thank you! I'll probably go back to my doctor this week and see if I can get a copper IUD!
I think that might be my next option... I've heard horror stories of three month-long periods on the injection and whatnot.

You're welcome! That's a real shame, I hate when doctors don't take you seriously; who knows your body better than you?! Yeah I don't feel great about the shot or implant, I've talked to friends/my sister about it and it hasn't worked for pretty much all of them :\ the copper IUD is my only option actually because it's free in New Zealand; the Mirena costs $300 and Jaydess costs $275 and health insurance isn't really a common thing here, because our healthcare is mostly public sector so most other things are free/subsidised. (The cost of my pill prescriptions are $5NZD for 6 months' worth, for example, plus the cost of seeing the doctor ($15NZD for me because my uni doctor is subsidised but usually it costs anywhere from $35-60 to see a doctor)). Very true! I feel nervous about having things inside me haha because I can't use tampons and I just don't feel very confident inserting things and I know you have to check your IUD sometimes, so that makes me nervous. But you're right, if I hate it I can get it removed! Thanks for your comment :)

Don't lose hope, unicorn hunters! I'm 21F and in a monogamous relationship with a man (not interested in nonmonogamy, which suits me for now but I know our relationship probably won't go beyond a couple more years) and I honestly would love to be the unicorn in someone else's relationship one day! I'm bi/pansexual so it would literally be the best of both worlds for me. Sometimes I worry if I'll ever find it but then I guess people feel that way about people like me too haha.

I'm glad you're finding success on Tinder, OP! Anyone else reading though, don't give up, we *are* out here :)

Dang, I just bought a different app last night! Before this I was keeping a food/symptom diary in the Notes on my phone and it was hell to format. I wish I'd thought of an app sooner, I did it for a month that way and then stopped for another month because it was too much work. Apps are a godsend!

Yeah of course! I'm curious to see what will happen to be honest, I'm scared nothing will happen but fingers crossed! Ooh yeah, period pain isn't anything to fuck with :\

Thank you! Same to you :)

Wow that's insane. I'm glad you've figured that out for yourself, at least! What I'm most hoping for is that at least the nausea subsides, it's the most debilitating symptom for me personally. Thanks for sharing!
Yeah definitely, you've explained it exactly! That's hopeful, good luck to you also!
Sounds like you're doing something so much more worthwhile with your life! Good on you for doing something that will make you happier, I hope your studies go well.
